Its Li content and simple, highly stable O2- framework should make it chemically compatible with the Li3InCl6 chloride electrolyte, and it is oxidatively robust near 4 V vs Li/Li+. A thin Li2O layer should therefore limit the interfacial reaction penalty at the LiCoO2 side.
